resolvedQuestions: Which one-off repair fixes should become permanent idempotent tooling, and where should each live?
What causes each validation failure class at the source, and how do we stop new instances?
How should an older or pre-v4 repo be detected and migrated or healed safely, and how does that fit /doctor:update?
What should be hardened in this branch's own changes: the CI rebuild job, the cleanup tools, the seeder, the Gate 3 wording and the token push?
Which checks belong in CI or pre-commit so drift is caught early and cheaply?

keyFindings.label: Two confirmed wrong-with-green-checks defects: rebuild job commits 1 of 4 tracked artifacts (silent sidecar drift) and spec.md.tmpl emits a conditional double /ANCHOR:questions close

Every hardening need already has a shipped mechanism covering most of it: upgrade-legacy orchestrates, repair-derived re-derives, heal-spec-docs fills defaults, upgrade-baseline records debt; gaps are coverage seams
upgrade-legacy.mjs is orphaned from /doctor:update - zero references anywhere in the doctor-update stack; the apply post-apply battery is the natural slot
repair-derived.cjs does not repair description.json specFolder, and that field is load-bearing: completion-state.cjs resolves it including an .opencode/specs fallback
ANCHORS_VALID rejects same-id re-open, stack-mismatch close, and leftover opens - the template defect is the second /ANCHOR:questions at line 425 behind a different level gate
METADATA_DISK_PATH_CONSISTENCY is the dominant baseline class (2,898 findings): archive.sh refreshes parent/track metadata but never rewrites a moved packet's own recorded paths
The 43 phase-013 manual lanes are one identical 9-rule playbook over 474 residual folders: four rules are mechanical and belong in heal-spec-docs; reconstruction must be verify-then-keep
changed-packet-validation.yml compares pass/fail verdicts only - a packet that worsens while remaining failed at base passes silently
strict-pass-freshness-report.yml never passes --baseline though the sweep tool implements regression/new-failure/known-failure statuses - the ratchet is inert
MIGRATION.md establishes the healing contract: indefinite legacy marker reads, current-version writes, never rewrite old packets to normalize marker style
Nine add-on templates ship trigger_phrases that the cleanup/census pair never touches - coverage seam, not missing capability
Gate 3 wording diverges: GATE_3_CHOICE_* constants exist but the question menu and mutation notice carry separate inline text
Old-layout detection already exists in the corpus walker (.opencode/specs alias-fold) and the v3 upgrade command refuses to write into .opencode/specs until moved
Archive semantics are dual: repair-derived freezes z_archive while upgrade-legacy --include-archive inspects and baselines archives without repairing - contract must be documented
fail-closed pre-commit validation would block all spec commits on machines lacking the built validator dist - gate on dist presence/freshness instead

ruledOutDirections: auto-repair inside /doctor:update apply (violates approval boundary)
corpus healing step inside release-update.cjs (engine scope wrong)
whole-corpus validation per PR (cost)
strict-pass-freshness as a merge gate (documented report-only design)
mandatory clean-tree gating for upgrade-legacy (would have blocked phase 013 concurrent repair)
fail-closed pre-commit validate without dist check
unconditional skeleton reconstruction (may itself fail sufficiency)
GitHub App token as required fix (custom app is real lift; PAT docs survive)
shipping scratchpad one-off scripts as-is
normalizing marker style in old packets (MIGRATION.md forbids)
healing archived packets (frozen-tree contract)
nested-anchor ban in validator (validator already permits different-id nesting)
prose-meaning edits by healers (structure-only boundary)
inventing history during reconstruction (dated-note or baseline-record only)
writing outside the lineage directory
running validate.sh during research (write side effects)
a new healing orchestrator binary (upgrade-legacy already is one)
per-file rollback snapshots for live trees (git reversal suffices)
renaming GATE_3 constants to match menus without checking consumers
expanding trigger-index job to commit untracked fixture files beyond the four tracked
auto-bumping markers during healing (staleness check owns that)
moving .opencode/specs trees automatically (operator must move)
treating convergence telemetry as a stop signal before cap
batching state records at end (contract requires immediate append)
synthesis_committed stem (drops stopReason in projection)
nested research dispatch (explicitly prohibited)
asking Gate 3 (pre-resolved by dispatch)
doc reconstruction without dated note
